newsitem.title: INDIA: Congress seeks ruling coalition backing for power.
newsitem.headline: Congress seeks ruling coalition backing for power.

text.p: India's Congress party on Monday said Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda should "gracefully resign" and his ruling United Front coalition should support a new Congress-led government.
"Deve Gowda should gracefully resign and the United Front should support a Congress-led government to help fight the communal forces," Congress spokesman Vithal Gadgil told a news conference.
Asked how Congress expected to form a government with backing from the coalition that it was seeking to topple from power, Gadgil said: "In politics, certain things are not stated publicly."
Gadgil said Congress had sent a letter to President Shankar Dayal Sharma "to stake our claim to form the government".
Congress on Sunday withdrew its make-or-break support to Deve Gowda's ten-month-old minority government, accusing it of not going far enough to counter the Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party.
